Method of Attack: Advertising SDK embedded in legitimate apps secretly siphoning user data and sending it to Chinese servers
Collecting call logs and other user data based on app permissions
Forcibly downloading and running code contained in large encrypted files to aid malicious behavior
Impacted Systems: Android apps using Igexin SDK (over 500 apps on Google Play Store)
Android ecosystem with over 100 million downloads
Attack Vector: Embedded advertising SDK in legitimate Android apps
Suspicious API requests to Igexin API server
